implementation: Prepare eligible fresh personal local workflow normalization and activity metadata in the existing detached preparation task. timestampContract: One operation timestamp is captured after instantiation, before worker history recording; final commit retains it. Cancel writes nothing. Failed-save retry prepares fresh history for the retained run identities.
inputAdmission: Copy-on-write array storage addresses are compared only inside simultaneous scoped read-only borrows of retained immutable arrays; no address escapes. This proves raw input identity. General metadata application separately validates exact raw fields with conservative fallback at depth 128.
nativeScope: Actual local template sheet create/Undo plus cloud cancel/dismiss/save retry/cold return; local 1,000/5,000-root append, prior root/child history, stale-source fallback, file failure rollback, widget intent retry/Undo/cold return and five publication fences. responsivenessScope: MainActor heartbeat is observed during background preparation; final synchronous commit, preparation and total are measured separately. This does not prove production animation/input latency, release performance or peak memory.
retainedCorpora: Metadata digest, 176 hierarchy cases, 375 date compatibility cases and 1,377 workflow body-size cases retain frozen outputs. Pulse corpus was not rerun in this stage.
comparison: Sequential unprofiled Debug observations compared with prior digest stage under variable host load. Total time may rise even when final blocking interval decreases.
